description: Interface definition for a JSON Web Token (JWT), including methods to access token components and a nested class defining JSON field constants.

classes.name: JsonWebToken
classes.description: Interface representing a JSON Web Token with methods to retrieve token data and a nested class for JSON field definitions.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header part of the JWT as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the body (payload) of the JWT as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getKeyId
methods.description: Returns the key identifier ('kid') of the JWT.

methods.name: getIssuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer ('iss') of the JWT.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature of the JWT.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the list of subjects ('sub') for authorization.

methods.name: getAudience
methods.description: Returns the audience ('aud') of the JWT.

methods.name: getAuthorizedParty
methods.description: Returns the authorized party ('azp') of the JWT.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Returns the list of scopes ('scope') of the JWT.

methods.name: getExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns the expiration time ('exp') as an Instant.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the JWT is expired.
